description: Synthetic comments written for this project (not YouTube data) for an independent creator's review of a fictional home espresso machine with a built-in grinder (not sponsored). Hold-out set for a later paired consolidation comparison: authored separately from t1-topics-v1, t2-topics-v1, t3-topics-v1 and t4-topics-v1 (different product domain, comments, taxonomy and gold), with the gold written before any provider run on it. Same schema and gold semantics as t1-t4: gold taxonomy, one gold topic disposition per non-spam comment and the sentiment toward its primary topic; overall classification labels are oracle inputs, not a classifier benchmark. Test fixtures only.

taxonomy.name: Espresso taste and extraction
taxonomy.definition: How the espresso shots taste and how evenly and consistently the machine extracts them.

taxonomy.name: Brew temperature stability
taxonomy.definition: How steady and accurate the brew water heat stays during a shot and across consecutive shots.

taxonomy.name: Built-in grinder
taxonomy.definition: Grind uniformity, adjustment steps, dosing and coffee retention of the integrated burr grinder.

taxonomy.name: Milk steaming
taxonomy.definition: How the steam wand heats and textures milk for milk-based drinks.

taxonomy.name: Cleaning and descaling
taxonomy.definition: Routine maintenance of the machine, including descaling, backflushing, emptying the drip tray, refilling the tank and changing the water filter.

taxonomy.name: Heat-up time
taxonomy.definition: How long the machine takes to become ready to brew after being switched on or woken from standby.

taxonomy.name: Operating noise
taxonomy.definition: How loud the pump, grinding and steaming are during normal use.

taxonomy.name: Controls and touchscreen
taxonomy.definition: How the touchscreen, dial and buttons are used to operate the machine and program shots.

taxonomy.name: Warranty claims and repairs
taxonomy.definition: How the manufacturer handles warranty claims, repairs, spare parts and support requests.
